data.title: Multi-Bank Funnel Pattern
data.description: Detects accounts receiving funds from multiple external financial institutions that are then consolidated and sent outbound to a single destination. This funnel pattern is a hallmark of money mule operations where proceeds from multiple fraud victims are aggregated before being laundered.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Multi-Bank Funnel Pattern")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_inbound | count(distinct originating_bank_id) by account_id > 3 and selection_outbound | count(distinct beneficiary_id) by account_id <= 2")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT")
originating_bank_external=true
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT")
| stats dc(originating_bank_id) as unique_originating_bank_id by account_id
| where unique_originating_bank_id > 3
| stats dc(beneficiary_id) as unique_beneficiary_id by account_id
| where unique_beneficiary_id <= 2

falsepositives: Freelancers or consultants receiving payments from multiple clients via different banks
Small businesses with receivables from diverse customer base
